profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Moda Health
profile.summary:
As a Principal Software Engineer at Nike with over a decade of experience, I specialize in software engineering practices, technical architecture, and consulting. My work emphasizes developing and implementing cloud-based solutions using AWS cloud services, Java/J2EE, and Node.js to drive innovation and efficiency in software development.  

Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, I contribute to full-stack software development initiatives that align with Nike's mission to deliver top-tier technical solutions. My dedication to engineering excellence is supported by expertise in Akamai Web Performance Foundations, ensuring scalable and high-performing applications.
